record.title: Run the frozen APK reader after correcting local ADB startup
record.intent: Test the APK mapping reader in a fresh disposable guest without changing the native hypothesis.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before execution. Correct only local ADB startup to omit -H for start-server; retain loopback endpoint and inherited child sandbox for all clients.
Keep build01 reader and fixture hashes, stock APK and exact48byte budget unchanged. Use fresh run directory; preserve the prior failed run.
Boot only disposable ARM64 guest, record stable policy and process identity, and verify staged files by roundtrip. Run three zero-read negatives then exactly one positive attempt.

Independently verify container-relative addressing, actual synthetic bytes, read counts, repeated metadata and file hashes. Stop on failure, preserve raw evidence, terminate own guest processes and commit/push.
acceptance: A fresh guest result or precise failure is preserved without physical contact.
